# Dreamina Canvas
## Plugin marketplaces

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| Full-stack development | Full Stack Plugins | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, qual

ity checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |

AIGC Plugins | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |
> Build Dreamina canvases from typed nodes and a timeline, keep the free save step separate from the
quoted run, and download assets with byte counts and SHA-256 receipts.
[](https://github.com/full-aigc-plugins/dreamina-canvas-plugin/releases) [](#skills) [](LICENSE)
English | 简体中文 · Install · Quick start · Skills · Architecture · Troubleshooting
## Positioning
`dreamina-canvas` turns a brief into a structured Dreamina canvas: typed nodes, a timeline, capabili
ty discovery at run time, a free draft save, then a quoted run that only executes after you approve
it. The plugin never hard-codes catalog values, never merges the save step with the run step, and ne
ver mints a replacement `submitId` to recover from a timeout.
It is a strict wrapper around the installed `dreamina-canvas` CLI and ships no MCP server: the eleve
n Skills drive the CLI through an argv-only adapter. Authentication and canvas state stay with the C
LI; the plugin persists only non-secret operation identifiers.
The historical real-environment acceptance records PASS for its listed CLI workflows. Current Window
s and paid visual-loop verification were not rerun. The add-canvas-visual-quality-loop change docume
nts the single-round local regression and remaining multi-round scope.
## Installation
### Prerequisites

- Python 3.11 or newer on `PATH`.
- The `dreamina-canvas` CLI, installed and authenticated before fi
rst use. The setup and auth Skills can run the official installer and login, but only after explicit

authorization, and the binary is never bundled.
- Visual-loop runtime dependency: `jsonschema` from

`requirements.txt`. Install with `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`.
- Development and tes
t gates additionally use `requirements-dev.txt`.

## Architecture and security
`dreamina-canvas-plugin` owns the adapter, the approval guard, the operation ledger and the artifact
guard. The CLI owns login and remote state; Dreamina owns the canvas service. The authors receive n
The CLI owns login and remote state; Dreamina owns the canvas service. The authors receive no asset.

- Save and run are separate operations; no quote means no approval is possible.
- An approval is bou

nd to the quoted node set and its project, and a consumed approval is rejected as a replay.
- Timeou
ts resume through the existing `submitId`; a missing ledger record escalates to a human instead of r

etrying.
- Only non-secret identifiers are persisted, and credential-like field names are rejected b
efore anything is written.
